claimBoundary: This cycle tests whether the public SH0ES compact release can support the anchor-, host-, and photometric-system interventions frozen in RC62. It may reproduce and stress-test the released 2022 linear ladder, but it cannot stand in for unreleased 2024-2025 HST, JWST, or SMC measurements.

officialRelease.description: SH0ES-2022 compact Gaussian linear system y, L, C and its reference least-squares solution

predeclaredTests.sourceIntegrity: Every file is fetched from the frozen commit and recorded by byte count, Git blob id, and SHA-256.

semanticIntervention.stop: Refuse named leave-one-anchor, leave-one-host, or leave-one-system causal estimates when a released row cannot be mapped to its measurement identity and covariance ancestry without inference, or when the public matrix predates the claimed measurement branch.

anonymousStressTest.claimLimit: Anonymous influence can locate concentration in the linear system but cannot identify an astrophysical anchor, host, instrument, or cause.

independentAudit.methodB: normal-equation solve from exported sufficient statistics in dependency-free Node

decisionRules.passLocalAuditContract: The baseline and semantic gates pass, every declared branch has a covariance-preserving deletion, and no branch shifts H0 by one baseline posterior sigma.
decisionRules.failLocalAuditContract: At least one named branch moves H0 by one sigma or more with an independently reproduced fit.
decisionRules.insufficientRelease: The numerical baseline passes but row labels, parameter labels, covariance ancestry, or current HST-JWST-SMC branch data are missing. Preserve the numerical results, refuse the named causal claim, and publish the minimum machine-readable release contract needed for the next cycle.
